title: Security Equipment for the United States Naval Academy
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSUP > NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT > NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK > NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description:
This requirement has been extended until 11/20/26. We are working to address contractor questions and will do so during this time.  

 This requirement is for specific security equipment for the United States Naval Academy as detailed in the Statement of Work included WITHIN the attached solicitation. This is a Brand Name requirement and all quoters submitting quotes in response to this solicitation shall be authorized resellers of AXIS, GENETEC, HPE, Corning, Ortronics by Legrand, and Assa Abloy brand equipment. Partial quotes will not be accepted. 

 All quotes in response to this solicitation shall be submitted to Contract Specialist Ashley Steele at ashley.n.steele8.civ@us.navy.mil by the date and time specified. Only electronic submissions will be accepted.
